scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives with Bloom levels: o1 「場面に合う権限モードを選べる」 (apply), o2 「見分けられる」 (analyze) and o3 「確認ルール（ask）を書ける」 (apply). Each has two or more questions at apply or analyze level: o1 by q1, q2, ps1, ps2 and e1; o2 by q5, e3 and e4; o3 by q3, q4, e5 and e6. One caveat: o3 says 「書ける」, but it is only assessed by choosing a rule (q4, e6). It is written only in the ungraded practice step p-rule.

hook-lead recalls lesson 1 and states a concrete problem with no trivia: 「便利ですが、pushまで知らないうちに進んだら困ります」. The ungraded predict q0 asks what a default v2.1.283+ session does with `git push`, which leads straight to o3. Each of its distractors gets feedback.

Prerequisites list lesson 1, cd/ls and commit/push, and hook-lead and rules-task recall lesson 1's `cc-practice`. 権限モード, 分類器, the rule terms and チェックポイント are defined before use and match the glossary, and auto-lead links 分類器 back to 「2-1の一覧で「安全チェック」と呼んだもの」. Two gaps remain: 「force pushや `git reset --hard`」 in auto-defaults is never explained, and modes-table names six modes in one segment, more than the 3-new-terms budget.

measure.mjs prints 「prose 2222 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2466 · practice reading 801 · questions 13 · practice sections 2 · est 19.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」, and lint --strict reports 0 warnings. Every segment ends in a check. However, modes-table brings in 7 names at once (権限モード plus six modes), and rules-defs brings in four rule names (権限ルール plus 許可・確認・拒否ルール), so two segments go past the 3-terms-per-segment budget.

rules-example comes before both practice sections. Each example-steps step has a subgoal label, a reason and an expect, for example 「pushは中身を見たいので[[確認ルール]]、`.env` は読ませないので[[拒否ルール]]にします」, and example-code and example-pitfall follow. There is no faded step between the full example and p-rule (「2-4を見ずに」). o1 has no worked example of choosing a mode with reasons; only the explanations of q1 and q2 do that job.

All five content sections end with an inline apply or analyze check (q1–q5), and every wrong option has feedback. Two items lean on recognition: q5's key 「Claudeが編集ツールで `app.js` に足した関数」 repeats rewind-how's wording 「Claudeのファイル編集ツールでの変更だけ」, and e5's key `git -C . push origin main` is the exact string in example-pitfall.

The questions target the brief's misconceptions, and each wrong option's feedback names and corrects one in two sentences or fewer. Examples are the auto-mode safety myth in q2 a (「Anthropicが2026年3月に示した評価で17%」), rule order in q3 a (「ルールの広さや書いた順では決まりません」), deny vs ask in q4 c and e6 a, the missing `*` in q4 d, 「CLAUDE.mdはClaudeへの助言」 in e6 d, and 'rewind replaces Git' in e4 a, b and c.

rules-diagram shows a process in 8 nodes, with labels that use the text's terms (拒否ルール/確認ルール/許可ルール/権限モード). Its caption states the takeaway, 「最初に一致したもので決まる」, and its alt describes the full flow. The two comparisons are narrow lists (modes-table, rewind-table), and the lesson has no decorative images.

practice-rules is an authentic task: write `.claude/settings.json`, predict, then trigger the deny and ask rules and a rewind in `cc-practice`, which lesson 1 created with `git init` and no remote. It has a hint ladder in p-rule (hint 「形は `Bash(…)` と `Read(…)` です」 → troubleshoot 「迷ったら、2-4のコードを写します」), success criteria in the expects, in rules-prompt (「`Read(./.env)` と `Bash(git push *)` が理由に挙がれば成功です」) and in rules-checklist. Weak spots: pr-transfer has no check you can observe, and pw-c-reason has no model answer.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam, and there are 7 flashcards plus 3 askTutor suggestions. summary-next gives a next action and 「次は「第3回｜探索→計画→実装→コミット」です。」, which matches course.json. There is no real reflection question; summary-next asks the learner to write a rule, which is an action.

Versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.283, v2.1.200), and the claims are cited to the official pages. The 17% figure is framed as the March 2026 post's measurement, as cross-lesson-facts.md item 2 requires. Every overclaim in audit-cc-02-permissions.json is fixed in the current text, for example example-pitfall 「autoモードでは、確認なしで通ることがあります」 and the 確認ルール entry 「`dontAsk` モードでは、確認せずに拒否します」. I found no claim that contradicts facts-cc-02-permissions.md or another block.

The text is です・ます throughout, calm and non-pressuring (「大事なリポジトリでは試さないでください」), and lint finds no banned phrases. Term use is mostly consistent; one inconsistency is that e6's options use `ask`/`deny` while q4's use 確認ルール/拒否ルール.

jp is the only declared locale, and it is complete; course.json also lists locales ['jp']. The diagram labels are Japanese, rules-diagram has a full alt, and the link text is descriptive: 「権限モードの公式ドキュメント（日本語）」. No text is baked into images.

niceToHave: rewind-check q5: test the mechanism rather than the phrase. Replace option b md with 「Claudeが `sed -i` コマンドで書き換えた `app.js` の1行」 and its feedback with 「同じファイルでも、Bashのコマンドでの変更は記録されません。戻すにはGitを使います。」.

check-quiz e5: the key repeats example-pitfall verbatim. Use 「`git -c push.default=current push origin main`」 as option c, so the item tests transfer of 「`git push` で始まらない」 (permissions page, quoted in audit-cc-02-permissions.json).

modes-table / modes-lead: since the table became a list, nothing labels what the text after 「：」 means, so 「Manual：読み取りだけ」 and 「プランモード：読み取りと調査だけ」 look almost the same. Add to modes-lead: 「一覧の「：」のあとは、確認なしで動く操作です。それ以外は確認が出ます（`dontAsk` では拒否）。」 (split if a sentence goes over 60 characters).
auto-defaults: explain the two Git terms, e.g. 「既定で止めるのは、force push（リモートの履歴を上書きするpush）や `git reset --hard`（手元の変更を捨てる操作）、本番へのデプロイなどです。」 (split the sentence if it goes over 60 characters).

rules-checklist: make pr-transfer checkable: 「応用：自分のコマンドを1つ確認ルールにし、`/permissions` に出ることを確かめました」. Add a model answer for pw-c-reason to the pw-restore expect: 「`rewind-copy.md` は残ります。`cp` はBashのコマンドなので、記録されないからです。」.
rules-steps: add a faded step between example-steps and p-rule by giving a skeleton in p-rule's hint: 「形は `{"permissions": {"ask": ["Bash(…)"], "deny": ["Read(…)"]}}` です。」.
auto-check q2: in auto mode a step can run before the learner sees it. Make the scenario realistic: 「autoモードで任せていたら、Claudeが「次に、本番サーバーの設定を書き換えるスクリプト（script）を実行します」と書きました。」.
summary-next: add a reflection question before the action: 「この回の予想で、外れたものはどれでしたか？」.
check-quiz e6: to match q4, write options a–c with the Japanese rule names, e.g. 「確認ルール（`ask`）に `Bash(gh pr create *)`」, if the 390 px width allows (ja-editor and visual-qa decide).
summary: Full review because the lesson moved to content/courses/claude-code/lessons/ and courseId changed to claude-code; the text has not changed. The lesson's main strength is its question design: every objective is assessed at apply or analyze level, and each distractor encodes a real misconception from the brief (auto-mode safety, rule order, deny vs ask, `*` placement, rewind vs Git). There are no must-fix items. The most useful improvements are to make q5 and e5 test transfer instead of matching the text, and to restore the 「確認なしで動く」 meaning that the modes list lost when the table was removed.
